WHY: the API catalog walk was IP-rate-limited (429). Wikimedia publishes the sanctioned bulk channel — dumps.wikimedia.org/<wiki>/latest/<wiki>-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2. This module ingests the dump instead of calling the API.

Build:
1. sources/wikisource_dump.py — dump streaming library, no network:
   a. iter_dump_pages(path) -> yields (ns:int, pageid:str, title:str, wikitext:str) via bz2 + xml.etree.ElementTree.iterparse, elem.clear() per page (constant memory).
   b. build_member_cats(path, entry_roots:dict[wiki->(root_cat, forced_slug|None)], max_depth=8) -> dict[wiki, dict[member_cat_title -> branch_slug]]: PASS 1 over the dump collecting ns-14 category pages (Категорија:* / Category:*) and the parent-category links in their wikitext; BFS/DFS from the entry roots computes the descendant set; _branch_for_cat resolves slugs exactly as the API walk does.
   c. iter_dump_candidates(path, wiki, member_cats) -> yields CatalogEntry for ns-0 pages whose wikitext contains [[<member cat>|...]]: foreign_identifier=f'{wiki}:{pageid}', meta={wiki,pageid,page_title,via:'dump',member_cat}.
   Reason (adversarial finding): ns-0 pages in book SUBCATS do not link the root category — a naive 'Народне песме' substring match would miss them. Membership is graph-derived, not name-matched.
2. wikisource_dump_ingest.py (folder root, next to fetch_lyrics_source.py) — CLI: --dump <path> --wiki sr|en [--limit N] [--offset N] [--resume]. For each candidate: reuse wikisource_pd's pipeline exactly — scan_license_templates (non-pd -> catalog 'dropped' with reason; conditional -> CC-BY-SA-4.0/cc-by-sa/conditional fields), wikitext_to_verse + MIN_VERSE_LINES + _link_heavy drops, _stanzas_to_sections(fold = wiki=='sr'), song dict in the SAME shape as wikisource_pd.fetch_lyrics output (corpus='wikisource_pd', source='wikisource_pd', script field, meta.via='dump' added). Write via _common.write_song_json into the corpus root (registry.corpus_root); mark catalog rows via Catalog.mark_entry; write_index at end. --resume skips pageids already in _catalog.json as fetched/dropped/skipped.
3. Refactor (minimal diff): extract the song-dict construction from wikisource_pd.fetch_lyrics into a module-level builder (e.g. _song_from_wikitext(entry, wt, parsed_title=None)) so API and dump paths share verdict logic; fetch_lyrics calls it — all 18 existing wikisource tests must stay green unchanged.
4. tests/test_lyrics_sources_dump.py + committed fixture tests/fixtures/lyrics_sources/wikisource_sample.xml (synthetic ~8 pages: 1 PD Cyrillic poem in a subcat of Народне песме, 1 page linking only a Vuk book cat, 1 non-PD license template, 1 TOC/link-heavy page, 1 too-short page, 1 en folk-song page, 2 ns-14 category pages forming root->subcat). Assert: emit/drop/conditional verdicts, Cyrillic->Latin fold, Strofa N sections, foreign_identifier format, resume skip on second run.
5. Pilot: if a dump is available under data/toolshop/lyrics/wikisource_pd/_src/, run --limit 50 --resume and quote counts; if not (download deferred to B7), run fixture-driven validation and mark the live pilot as deferred-for-B7 in the handoff — do NOT fake output.

Commit per lane rules (explicit pathspec; CHANGELOG ID allocated at merge — cite 'lyrics-p2' lane until then). Handoff: ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_sources/wave_p2_a1/D1_handoff.md with quoted exit codes, test counts, one verbatim emit/drop example.
